g.title: j2163639625
g.text: How're you feeling today? Marie told me you were laid up with a megrim.

g.title: j1086757584
g.text: How're you feeling today? Marie told me you were laid up with a migraine.

g.title: j101927752
g.text: Ah. Yes. I was. I am feeling much recovered today, thank you for asking. Though I do not know as I enjoy overmuch that Marie has told you about my ailment.

g.title: j161582704
g.text: I see, that must be this era's word for my severe headaches. Yes, I was. I am feeling much recovered today, thank you for asking. Though I do not know as I enjoy overmuch that Marie has told you about my ailment.

g.title: j2674057495
g.text: She only said you weren't well out of concern for you.

g.title: j1731666081
g.text: It just came up in passing. She didn't tell me to check on you.

g.title: j3463475852
g.text: I am doing well, thank you kindly for asking. How are you?

g.title: j1197278315
g.text: It will likely come as no surprise to you that I prefer my business to remain private.

g.title: j291644954
g.text: Of course. Marie would cure the world with all the rays of Sol if she could. But it will likely come as no surprise to you that I prefer my business to remain private.

g.title: j881787413
g.text: I'm all right. I was just checking in, I heard you weren't doing well yesterday.

g.title: j36016330
g.text: I'm fighting a bit of a megrim, personally.

g.title: j3438847060
g.text: I'm fighting a bit of a migraine, personally.

g.title: j3534641122
g.text: I'm fighting a bit of a headache, personally.

g.title: j2603074604
g.text: I just know from personal experience that sometimes the moments we don't want to accept help from others are the precise moments we need that help the most.

g.title: j1147541505
g.text: I respect that. I won't pry if you don't want to talk. But I am here to listen if you do.

g.title: j2849513076
g.text: She seemed to imply that you had theories as to why you get these headaches?

g.title: j833167146
g.text: Marie thinks you're trying to carry the burden of all of this alone. I wanted you to know I'm here.

g.title: j2440472782
g.text: Marie believes you are needlessly suffering through this whole situation. I was wondering if I could help.

g.title: j2334873600
g.text: Ah. I see. I am feeling much recovered today, thank you for asking. Though I do not know as I enjoy overmuch that Marie has told you about my ailment.

g.title: j4014717271
g.text: I imagine that is this era's word for the severe headaches I suffer from as well. I cannot imagine staring at the glow of this contraption helps it. You should go and lie down.

g.title: j2779131633
g.text: I suffer from those as well. I cannot imagine staring at the glow of this contraption helps it. You should go and lie down.

g.title: j1770395038
g.text: I'm not saying this moment is that time. But if that time comes? I'm here.

g.title: j2848015776
g.text: And such theories are, unfortunately, now cast quite firmly into "the Void."

g.title: j3392247813
g.text: You will have to pardon me, Drifter, when I say this:

g.title: j3712321688
g.text: Hm. I suffer from those as well. I cannot imagine staring at the glow of this contraption helps it. You should go and lie down.

g.title: j1021871235
g.text: You're right. I'll go. I just wanted to see how you were, first.

g.title: j654160993
g.text: You caught me. I'm just not sure how else to... connect with you.

g.title: j1564508172
g.text: I'll be all right for a little longer. How long have you suffered from these kinds of headaches?

g.title: j3462529857
g.text: What is that supposed to mean?

g.title: j685274882
g.text: I am surrounded now by strangers and talking beasts in a world of fantastical madness and seemingly endless and rampant slaughter.

g.title: j2351002581
g.text: I appreciate your willingness to admit to a lie so readily. And I appreciate the fact that I am not... the most affable creature with which you engage.

g.title: j635101644
g.text: It is a personal matter, Drifter. I appreciate your attempt at conversing with me. And I appreciate the fact that I am not... the most affable creature with which you engage.

g.title: j2173627064
g.text: All that I have known has been swept away by glowing beams of "Jade Light" and "the Orokin Empire" and "the Void" and is threatened by "the Murmur."

g.title: j2402938145
g.text: As you can "see," I am quite recovered. And now you must worry about yourself. Now go find a dark place to recover.

g.title: j636951470
g.text: May I be blunt and ask as to why you are attempting to socialize with me at all?

g.title: j1777016605
g.text: So, you will have to excuse me if I find this... offer of kinship from you oddly laughable in its naïveté. I neither know you nor trust you. Indeed, all I have to go on is the word of others.

g.title: j4182863348
g.text: Begone, Drifter. Before I find you and force you to rest. And none of us will enjoy that.

g.title: j3382300933
g.text: If we're being blunt, I honestly cannot stop thinking about you ever since we met.

g.title: j692991899
g.text: Entrati เปลี่ยนเจ้าให้กลายเป็น Protoframe และตอนนี้เจ้าอยู่ที่นี่ ไม่ต้องเตรียมตัวอะไรเลย ถ้าข้าช่วยเจ้าปรับตัวได้ ก็อยากช่วยนะ

g.title: j615378872
g.text: Well...? I think you're fascinating. I want to get you know you better.

g.title: j3094951870
g.text: The word of others whom I also neither know nor trust as of yet. All of this is heaped upon us, never mind the burdens you cannot see.

g.title: j723989379
g.text: Well... I might enjoy that more than you think.

g.title: j3769213830
g.text: So, I appreciate your affability and apologize for the lack of mine own. I know what you are attempting, and I commend you for it. And I hope, that should the time come that I am in need of your aid, the offer still stands.

g.title: j2093401917
g.text: In the words of a dear friend, "i'm stubborn, m8."

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be LyonFlirt.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be LyonFlirt.
